messages:
Maya (Finance): Noticed a sharp GPU spend spike for February in the hosted cluster. Can we get a rapid allocation by team/customer? Need to decide on reserves.

billing-bot: Alert: project=hosted-models gpu_cost > baseline x2.5 since 2026-02-13. See /alerts/177420.

Owen (Infra): Which cost lines look abnormal? If jobs lack tags they land in shared bucket. Can you paste the top cost rows?

Maya (Finance): Paste from cost API:
```
2026-02-14 hosted-models gpu A100 $31,600 tags: team=ml,customer=acme
2026-02-15 hosted-models gpu A100 $18,200 tags: team=null,customer=null
2026-02-16 hosted-models gpu A100 $14,000 tags: team=platform,customer=internal
```
Row 2 is untagged and large.

Priya (ML): That likely corresponds to our grid search sweep `hf-quant-sweep`. We used long sequences and accidental non-preemptible nodes. cc @Owen

Owen (Infra): Run this quick query to isolate untagged jobs:
```
cost-lookup --project hosted-models --from 2026-02-12 --to 2026-02-17 --filter "tag:team==null" --group-by job_name
```
I'll lock autoscale if we find a runaway.

Marcus (Product): Finance needs a best-effort mapping now. Can infra map job_name -> repo -> owner? A provisional split is fine.

Owen (Infra): Got it. Top untagged jobs: `hf-quant-sweep-02`, `dataset-dedup-2026`. Mapping via CODEOWNERS gives owners: Priya, DataEng respectively. Sending CSV.

Maya (Finance): Received CSV. Provisional chargeback applied: ML (Priya) $29,800, DataEng $9,400, Platform $3,500. Filing transfer up to $15k auto-approve; remainder needs finance director signoff.

Priya (ML): Confirmed `hf-quant-sweep-02` was ours and used wrong template (`gpu-large-nopreempt`) by mistake. We'll cover part and request a transfer for the rest. How to request?

Maya (Finance): File ticket FIN-4910 in finance-tools w/ invoice and justification. I'll pre-approve $15k.

Owen (Infra): Short-term mitigation: enforce `--team` at job submit, add soft cap 36h on sweep templates. Also raising alert thresholds to catch spikes earlier.

Marcus (Product): Adding a slide to monthly ops review: process fix + guardrails + alert tuning.

billing-bot: Ticket FIN-4910 created by Maya (Finance)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4910

Priya (ML): Thanks. We'll re-run the sweep with preemptible nodes after approvals and put a postmortem on the ML board.
